line: Crowley on Atu IV: the letter Tzaddi, Aries under Mars, Chokmah and Tiphareth, and the Path of Hé (pdf p66, p67, p211).

sections.title: Letter and sign
sections.line: Crowley refers the card to the letter Tzaddi and to the sign Aries, ruled by Mars (pdf p66).

quotes.quote: This card is attributed to the letter Tzaddi, and it refers to the sign of Aries in the Zodiac.
This sign is ruled by Mars, and therein the Sun is exalted.

sections.title: Chokmah, Tiphareth and the Path of Hé
sections.line: Crowley on authority derived from Chokmah and exerted upon Tiphareth (pdf p67), on the white light that indicates the card's position in the Tree of Life (pdf p67), and on the Path of Hé (pdf p211).

quotes.quote: His authority is derived from Chokmah, the creative Wisdom, the Word, and is exerted upon Tiphareth, the organized man.
the white light which descends upon him indicates the position of this card in the Tree of Life
Path of Hé, the Great Mother, the Star, our Lady Nuit,

sections.title: The figure and its power
sections.line: Crowley's description of the crowned male figure (pdf p66) and of the sudden, violent, impermanent activity it represents (pdf p67).

quotes.quote: The card represents a crowned male figure, with imperial vestments and regalia.
With regard to the quality of this power, it must be noted that it represents sudden, violent, but impermanent activity.
